answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network anchors every agent to an economic wharf where identity registration requires cryptographic stake burning. Before docking, each entity solves a verified cipher puzzle and irreversibly burns capital scaled as C(n) = k * n^2. This superlinear cost enforces a steep financial mesa an attacker must climb; duplicating puppet agents scales exponentially in aggregate loss, making large-scale spoofing economically ruinous.
